module: "Neutral" gearbox logic module loaded by vehicleController when the vehicle has no "gearbox" device (or via jbeam shiftLogicName = "dummy"). It simply copies the driver's throttle/brake inputs, reads the speed of the "mainEngine" engine if it exists and fills in the values (temperatures, load, torques, engine state) that vehicleController publishes in electrics. No gear changes.
notes: Contract common to all shiftLogic modules: before each frame vehicleController injects gearboxHandling, timer, timerConstants, inputValues, shiftPreventionData, shiftBehavior and smoothedValues (nil at module creation), then reads throttle, brake, clutchRatio, rpm, etc.
gearboxBehaviorChanged, shiftUp, shiftDown and shiftToGearIndex are `nop` (engine global, not defined in this file): they do nothing.
updateGearboxGFX also writes M.running and M.isShifting, which are not declared in the module's initial table (vehicleController does not read M.running; it reads isShifting).
clutchRatio stays at 0 and the engine receives the raw throttle value (0 if engine disabled).

smoothedAvgAVInput.desc: Angular velocity (rad/s) of the "gearbox" device output (0 if absent).

rpm.desc: Engine speed in RPM (outputAV1 of the mainEngine).

maxRPM.desc: Engine max RPM read at init.

engineThrottle.desc: Throttle sent to the engine (0 if engine disabled).

isEngineRunning.desc: 1 if the engine is running (speed > 80% of starterMaxAV and starter disengaged) or if it has no starter, otherwise 0.

waterTemp.desc: Coolant temperature (or oil temperature as a fallback).

checkEngine.desc: True if the engine is disabled (isDisabled).

init.desc: Stores sharedFunctions, gets the mainEngine and gearbox devices, resets values to zero and reads the engine's maxRPM/idleRPM/energy. Called by vehicleController at init and reset.

updateGearboxGFX.desc: Every frame: copies the inputs and updates rpm, temperatures, load, torques, ignition and engine state.

sendTorqueData.desc: Asks the engine to send its torque curves to the UI (if an engine exists).
